title: nautilocalyx panamensis
intro: Nautilocalyx panamensis, commonly known as Panamian nautilocalyx or Nautilocalyx, is a species of flowering plant in the family Boraginaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its rich profile of bioactive constituents, which provide several health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Nautilocalyx panamensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
